status: DRAFT — pending spec-writer validation and user approval at the spec gate

acceptance_criteria.statement: The full pytest suite passes with no failures or errors and the existing test count does not drop.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pip install -e ".[dev]" && pytest -q  # exit code 0, >= 62 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors
acceptance_criteria.from_constraint: make sure everything works still (regression safety)

acceptance_criteria.statement: The invespend CLI surface is unchanged: `invespend --help` and each subcommand (init-db, ingest, report, statements, backfill-hashes, backup) parse and expose the same commands and flags as before the refactor.
acceptance_criteria.verify: Capture `invespend --help` and each subcommand `--help` before the refactor; after the refactor re-capture and diff — must be identical.
acceptance_criteria.from_constraint: no behavioural change to the platform

acceptance_criteria.statement: Database migrations still apply in order on a fresh database and the build-layer views/schema are unchanged (same objects, same columns).
acceptance_criteria.verify: Apply db/migrations/*.sql in order on a clean SQLite/Postgres-compatible harness; assert the documented tables and views exist with unchanged columns (db tests in tests/ pass).

acceptance_criteria.statement: A REFACTORING_PLAN.md exists at the repo root, mapping each proposed change to the modules it touches, its risk level, and which acceptance criterion guards it.
acceptance_criteria.verify: File exists at repo root and contains, at minimum, sections: Scope, Staged Changes (each with module + risk + guarding criterion), Out-of-scope, Rollback. Two reviewers score presence identically.
acceptance_criteria.from_constraint: suggest a refactoring plan for the whole repo

acceptance_criteria.statement: Public import paths and the console entry point are preserved: `from invespend.cli import main` resolves and the `invespend` script runs.
acceptance_criteria.verify: python -c "import invespend, invespend.cli, invespend.ingest, invespend.report, invespend.statements, invespend.db; from invespend.cli import main" && invespend --help
acceptance_criteria.from_constraint: no behavioural change; importers keep working

acceptance_criteria.statement: No secrets or credentials are committed; `.env` remains git-ignored and only `.env.example` (no values) is tracked. A read-only scan finds no hardcoded secrets.
acceptance_criteria.verify: git check-ignore .env  # ignored; git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)\.env$' returns nothing; risk-security secret scan reports 0 findings.
acceptance_criteria.from_constraint: security model — secrets never touch the repo

acceptance_criteria.statement: Refactored modules are measurably more maintainable: no dead code introduced, no module grows without justification, and duplicated logic is consolidated where the plan says so.
acceptance_criteria.verify: Per the REFACTORING_PLAN.md targets: compare per-module line counts and structure before/after; reviewer confirms each claimed consolidation is real and no orphaned/unused code remains.

out_of_scope: New features or new CLI subcommands
Behavioural changes to ingestion, reporting, or statement generation
Dependency upgrades beyond what a refactor strictly requires
Activating/deploying (Supabase project, GitHub secrets, enabling crons)
coverage_note: F1-F3,F6 are the hard regression/security gates (Must). F4,F5,F7 capture the deliverable plan and maintainability (Should). Drafted outside the loop; spec-writer should confirm completeness and minimality before freezing.
